rules.statement: The RTL must follow the VLSIT RTL Design Rules v2 (REF-003) as the mandatory RTL coding authority.
The RTL must comply with the VLSIT RTL Design Rules without local exceptions.
Every flip-flop, including the payload registers, must have the asynchronous reset of section 7.3.
FSM signals must be named reg_fsm_apb_current_state, w_fsm_apb_nxt_state, reg_fsm_tlul_current_state, w_fsm_tlul_nxt_state with ENUM_ST_* members.

Coding style: one module per file named as the module, structural top, ANSI ports with input wire and output logic, reg_/w_/p_ff_/p_com_ names, PARA_* parameters with three PAR-02 comment lines, names at most 30 characters, comment lines at most 100 characters.
m_apb_tlul_bridge is the structural top containing only ports, parameters, interconnect wires and the two instances, in CLK-CORE/RST-CORE domains.
m_apb_if, instance u_apb_if, must contain all APB-facing logic: Setup detect, legality check, APB FSM and response flops reg_pready, reg_pslverr, reg_prdata.
m_tlul_if, instance u_tlul_if, must contain all TL-UL-facing logic: channel A flops, TL-UL FSM, reg_d_ready and D-channel check.
State is owned by m_apb_if and m_tlul_if; m_apb_if has no TL-UL port and m_tlul_if has no APB port.
Lint uses the project lint set with default_nettype none checking, waiving only the unused inputs i_apb_pprot, i_tlul_d_param, i_tlul_d_size, i_tlul_d_sink, i_tlul_d_user.
